title: Offer detail (M2)
brief: Offer detail screen of goop, opened with enter on an offer row: header with score, verdict, NEW, source and date; why it fits (matched requirements, gaps, seniority); goop's summary; a pointer to the untrusted original text (M3); no key-hint line under the header: the status line (detail focus mode) carries the offer keys enter apply, s save, a ask goop, d dismiss, o open, f full text, [ ] prev/next, esc back. Below the screen: the toast with ctrl+z undo, the apply ask (y yes · n no) and the dismiss reason ask.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Calmest read with requirements and summary side by side; hides the list and the chat, so moving between offers needs [ ] or esc
